title: Product catalog from the active policy

operations.text:
- Step 1: write acceptance tests first in specs/test_artefacts/acceptance/test_e2_s1_catalog.py (AC1-AC5), run record-at-red.js while red; API tests in backend/tests/api/test_products.py
- Step 2: add migration backend/migrations/0002_policy_versions.sql (policy_versions table, trigger aborting DELETE and any UPDATE except DRAFT to APPROVED)
- Step 3: add policy file backend/policies/policy_v0001.json (three products, min_income 25000.00/30000.00/20000.00, required_documents 3/4/4, string decimals only)
- Step 4: add backend/src/truelend/repository/policy_repo.py (insert/read policy_versions, active = MAX APPROVED)
- Step 5: add backend/src/truelend/service/policy_service.py (seed version 1 APPROVED with file SHA-256, startup verify raising POLICY_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, catalog with Decimal money)
- Step 6: add backend/src/truelend/api/products_router.py (GET /api/products, any authenticated role) and wire seed plus verify into backend/src/truelend/api/main.py lifespan
